1. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node is configured to transmit to a second node at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the nodes is configured to provide an indicia of its inter-node interference to others of the plurality of nodes, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia __from at least one other node of the plurality of nodes__.

2. (Original)

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is __dynamically__ based on a minimum desired throughput for each particular node __and is adjusted when the minimum desired throughput changes__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on __a ratio of__ the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node __to__ an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more of the nodes interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

5. (Original)

13. (Original)

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast __a dynamic weight associated with the second node__ to the first node.

15. (Original)

16. (Original)

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and __the first node's transmissions interfere with communication between the second node and the second access point, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust its access attempt percentage based on the interference caused to the second node's communication with the second access point__.

18. (Original)

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to communicate with the first access point using __a wireless protocol compliant with IEEE 802.11 standards__.
